name: French LEquipe
description: 我们是北京的法国队（成立于1994年），自国际足球联赛创建以来，我们一直坚持不懈地奋斗。如今，球队里有超过10个国家的球员，展现了真正的友谊无国界的精神，以及自由、平等、博爱的普世价值。30年来，我们始终如一。在我们的历史中，我们曾两次夺冠：2008-2009赛季的甲级联赛冠军和2021-2022赛季的三级联赛冠军。

name: Red Cards
description: Founded in 2000, Red Cards is a soccer team for Japanese expats based in Beijing. The team mainly consists of Japanese and Japanese-speaking Chinese members. Our goal is to strengthen ties among teammates through soccer, fostering a spirit of “wa” (harmony), and bring together Japanese people and soccer enthusiasts. When it’s game time though, we can be competitive, with adults and students giving their all in every match to win.
